rationale: Reactive current is k*(deadband-voltage) for all samples below the 0.9 pu deadband, with reactive priority under the 1.2 pu current limit. Active current remains at the 0.92 pu prefault value except at t160, where it is reduced to the remaining apparent-current capability. All voltages remain above the 0.45 pu FRT floor for the sampled interval, so ride-through and reactive-current requirements are met.
